id.description: Globally unique identifier for this decision.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Decision.

entityType.description: Entity category for this object, normally Decision.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

subject.description: Stable IFS reference to the object, proposal, rule, resource, or question being decided. Kept as a reference string because a decision subject can point to heterogeneous resources.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the decision.

previousRevisionId.description: Id of previous revision of this decision, If this decision is a modified version of another decision.

previousRevision.description: Current outcome of the decision, if the decision has produced an outcome at least once.

eligibleMembers.description: Member entities eligible to participate in this decision.

affectedMembers.description: Member entities affected by this decision under the IFS scope rule.

votes.description: Vote entities cast directly by members or by delegates acting on their behalf.

rules.description: Rule entities that govern eligibility, delegation, quorum, thresholds, timing, or outcome calculation for this decision.

eligibleMemberCount.description: Snapshot count of members eligible to participate.

affectedMemberCount.description: Snapshot count of members affected by this decision.

voteCount.description: Snapshot count of votes currently recorded for this decision.

delegateVoteCount.description: Snapshot count of votes cast by delegates on behalf of eligible members.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision opened for participation.

closedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision closed.

cancelledAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision was cancelled.

verifiedAt.description: Optional timestamp when participation, vote data, or outcome was verified.

approvedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision produced an approved outcome.

rejectedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision was rejected or produced a rejected outcome.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was last updated.

decidedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was decided.
